reason: 该插件的主要用途是提升 DeepSeek Harness 输入界面的氛围与交互反馈：通过在输入区域显示并高亮键盘/鼠标状态、加入打字火焰和抖动、回答完成提示音与页面轻震等效果来增强可见反馈。依据 README 与 package.json 的说明，其能力集中在本地界面可视化与音效/动画反馈，无外部服务调用或复杂数据处理。

summaries.zh: dsh-vibe 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 网页端氛围插件，提供实时键盘与鼠标可视化、打字火焰、抖动和回答提示音等输入反馈，并可通过设置页或配置文件调节效果。
summaries.en: dsh-vibe is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds real-time keyboard and mouse visualization plus typing and response feedback effects such as particles, subtle vibration, and completion sounds, with configurable settings.

capabilities: real-time keyboard and mouse event visualization in the chat input area
local UI feedback effects for typing and AI response completion
user-configurable settings for effect toggles and intensity

reasons.code: README describes a 87-key TKL keyboard and mouse panel with real-time key/button highlighting and animated transitions, indicating direct input-event visualization.
README and package description list typing flames, input shake, page shake, and completion sound as active feedback behaviors, with intensity controls and enable switches.
Package manifest defines a web client DSH plugin with packaged patch config for defaults and a dedicated settings panel, showing local UI control/formatting scope.
